verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing can be driven entirely without a UI. Subscriptions can be created through the Subscriptions API, the official Stripe CLI lets you build, test and manage the integration from the command line, and isolated sandboxes let automated runs avoid touching live data. Pinned API versions add stability for scripted use. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation (e.g., non-interactive CLI auth or CI recipes), independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Build, test, and manage your Stripe integration from the command line.
Create a new subscription in the Dashboard or with the Subscriptions API.
A sandbox is an isolated test environment. You can use your sandbox to test Stripe functionality in your account, and experiment with new features without affecting your live integration.
